1. A task is started by the supervisor; scanning is possible only after joining via QR and downloading the snapshot.
2. During a task, sales and stock in/out are paused.
3. Hold the device trigger to batch-scan; on phones without a UHF module, tap the hint to scan barcodes with the camera (barcode = EPC). Reads upload automatically, with no start/finish buttons.
4. Scanning and uploading stop automatically when the supervisor ends the task; each device gets a temporary number for the task.
5. The device periodically pulls items scanned by other devices.
6. Only new records are pulled to save traffic.
7. With one device, nothing is pulled and alerts are local.
8. With multiple devices, records merge into one full table.
9. Offline use is unaffected; data syncs when reconnected.
10. Online shows the global view; offline shows only local.
11-13. Offline reads are queued and auto-uploaded; foreign items are still flagged.
14. The full store item list is downloaded before scanning for instant comparison.
15. Foreign items are flagged red and set aside.
16. Missing high-value items stay pinned on top.
17. Send when possible, queue when not; auto-retry later.
18. Duplicate reads count once.
19. Order: abnormal > missing HV > scanned HV > normal > other-device.
20. The device only scans/compares/uploads; the backend computes differences.
21. Sales resume only after the supervisor reviews the merged result.
